summary.en: Women are leading the youth-led "Cockroach" protests across India and the movement's leader has been arrested as security forces intensify the crackdown. In Manipur, the Kuki-Zo Women’s forum says the crisis is political and has called for President's Rule, while Congress accuses the BJP of governance failure and houses were torched in an abandoned village amid ethnic tensions. The Ekta Diwas parade will feature 2,000 artists from 126 Naxal-hit districts with Prime Minister Modi attending. 437 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kvinner leder de ungdomsdrevne “Cockroach”-protestene over hele India, og bevegelsens leder er blitt arrestert mens sikkerhetsstyrkene intensiverer nedslaget. I Manipur sier Kuki-Zo-kvinnene-forumet at krisen er politisk og har krevd presidentstyre, mens Kongressen anklager BJP for styringssvikt og hus ble brent i en forlatt landsby midt i etniske spenninger. Ekta-Diwas-paraden vil ha 2 000 kunstnere fra 126 naksal-rammede distrikter, med statsminister Modi til stede. 437 dødsfall i kamp ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
